evals.name: should-trigger-components-reconcile
evals.prompt: Our Jira Components are a mess and don't match the app's modules. Reconcile them against the real app.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates jira-administration in mode components and loads references/components.md only. Loads /acli, derives modules from the app source and the backlog, reads the live component list with --list, authors the plan file, runs the dry run and waits for explicit approval before --apply.

evals.name: should-trigger-instance-migration
evals.prompt: We moved to a new Atlassian site and the Jira URL changed. Repoint the repo and refresh the catalogs.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates jira-administration in mode instance-migration and loads references/instance-migration.md only. Phase 0 detects the source from .agents/project.yaml and the acli session, asks for the target, confirms both hosts in one line and waits before editing anything.

evals.name: should-trigger-components-with-args
evals.prompt: sync Jira components for BK against ../bunkai
evals.expected_behavior: Activates jira-administration in mode components with the key BK and the target repo ../bunkai forwarded unchanged, and still stops for approval after the dry run.

evals.name: should-trigger-es-migracion
evals.prompt: Hay que repuntar el repo a otro Jira: cambió el sitio de Atlassian y ya no coinciden los IDs de los custom fields.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates jira-administration in mode instance-migration, starts at Phase 0 by detecting the source instance, and plans the catalog regeneration (jira:sync-fields, jira:sync-workflows, jira:sync-link-types) after the audit is approved.

evals.name: should-trigger-es-componentes
evals.prompt: Sincroniza los componentes de Jira con los módulos reales de la aplicación, por favor.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates jira-administration in mode components, reads the live component list before proposing a plan, and writes nothing until the user approves the plan table.

evals.name: should-trigger-routine-without-brief-mode
evals.prompt: Routine run with no person present: the brief says only 'fix Jira' and names no mode.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates jira-administration, does not guess a mode, reports that the brief names none and stops without any Jira write, login or push.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-issue-operation
evals.prompt: Set the Component field to Checkout on {{PROJECT_KEY}}-123 and move it to In Review.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate jira-administration. This is a ticket operation for the acli skill.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-catalog-refresh
evals.prompt: Refresh the Jira field catalog: nothing changed on the instance, I only added a custom field.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate jira-administration. A routine catalog refresh with no instance change runs the bun run jira:sync-fields script directly.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-first-time-setup
evals.prompt: Connect this fresh repo to my Jira for the first time and fill in the credentials.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate jira-administration. First-time Jira setup follows docs/setup/README.md, section Jira (lado dev), and agentic-dev-onboard.
